FN-2JW75IK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 481
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/01/2025
House Bill 481 as introduced could increase or decrease obligations of certain state and local
government bodies by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of
materials or equipment purchased through certain cooperative purchase agreements, general
services administration contracts, or other certain alternative methods provided by this bill, and
the cost of these materials or equipment if acquired under current law.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 481
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Economic Development
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 04/21/2025
House Bill 481 as passed by the House of Representatives could increase or decrease
obligations of certain state and local government bodies by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the difference in the cost of materials or equipment purchased through certain cooperative
purchase agreements, general services administration contracts, or other certain alternative
methods provided by this bill, and the cost of these materials or equipment if acquired under
current law.
